mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the Federal Funds Rate above 2.25% for three consecutive months reduces the present value of future equity cash flows, thereby depressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 2.25% and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns show no statistically significant negative relationship with the FEDFUNDS rate change (p > 0.05 in OLS).

mechanism_narrative: When the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeds 0.3% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver positive 20-day forward returns as market participants anticipate rate cuts later in the quarter.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% and remains above for 2 months
failure_condition: In samples where CPIAUCSL > 0.3% for >2 months, 20-day SPX returns are not statistically outperforming the risk-free rate (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in monthly PAYEMS (labor market activity) accompanied by a decline in UNRATE (unemployment) suggests strengthening labor demand, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >10% from the prior month while UNRATE decreases by >0.2 percentage points
failure_condition: In 5-day windows meeting the trigger, SPX 5-day returns are not significantly higher than the mean of non-trigger windows (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly expansion in INDPRO (industrial production) exceeding 2% while simultaneously showing no sharp decline in HOUST (housing starts) indicates robust industrial supply growth with minimal housing weakness, predicting positive 20-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: Over 20-day windows with INDPRO > +2% and HOUST flat, SPX returns show no outperformance relative to a supply-neutral benchmark (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls by more than 5% in a month while UNRATE remains below 7%, it signals deteriorating consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In 60-day windows matching the trigger, SPX 60-day returns are not significantly worse than in a demand-neutral period (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in GDPC1 (real GDP) by over 2% in the prior quarter is a leading indicator of economic contraction, associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows following GDPC1 < -2%, SPX 20-day returns are not statistically lower than in the prior quarter's median (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a regime where UNRATE falls below 5% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 is expected to exhibit positive 5-day forward returns as lower unemployment is interpreted as a pro-equity signal.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: In 5-day windows with UNRATE < 5% for 2 months, SPX 5-day returns are not higher than the average of non-low-unemployment windows (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of INDPRO exceeds 102 (from a 100 baseline) while HOUST remains flat, it indicates resilient industrial supply capacity, predicting positive 20-day SPX returns.
failure_condition: In 20-day windows matching the trigger, SPX returns are not statistically superior to a supply-neutral 20-day window (p > 0.05).
